setup: The two points are given and the distance is wanted.

steps.say: For the ordinary case, take the horizontal change and the vertical change between the points: the horizontal move is [[dx]] and the vertical move is [[dy]].
These are the legs of a right triangle, so the straight-line distance is the hypotenuse: √([[dx_sq]] + [[dy_sq]]) = √([[sum_sq]]) = [[dist]].
